requirements.requirement: The system must render the clinical trial phase label (I, II, III, or IV) correctly in the MessageBubble UI given valid input data.
The system must display a plain-language explanation corresponding exactly to the provided phase value (I/II/III/IV) as defined in the interpretation logic.
The system must display the phase score contribution value in the UI when it is present in the input payload.
The system must render phase label, explanation, and score contribution together within a single MessageBubble without layout breakage.
The system must correctly render phase information when delivered through the ChatWindow component end-to-end from input message to visible UI.
The system must ensure the explanation text shown to the user matches the expected predefined explanation for the given phase with no truncation or mutation.
The system must render phase data consistently across multiple messages in a chat session without variation for identical inputs.
The system must correctly handle all valid phase values (I, II, III, IV) and produce distinct UI outputs for each.
The system must not display a score contribution field when the contribution value is absent or null in the input.
The system must gracefully render a fallback UI state when the phase value is missing, without causing UI errors or crashes.
The system must display a default explanation indicating unknown phase when an invalid phase value is provided.
The system must ensure that LLM-generated explanation text (if used) semantically aligns with the predefined meaning of the phase and does not contradict it.
The system must ensure that LLM-generated explanation text does not introduce medical claims beyond the scope of the phase definition.
The system must ensure that LLM-generated explanation text remains under a defined character limit suitable for MessageBubble display.
The system must ensure that LLM-generated explanation text uses consumer-friendly language (no clinical jargon beyond defined terms).
The system must ensure that LLM-generated explanation text is deterministic for identical inputs within test conditions.
The system must ensure that LLM-generated explanation text includes an explicit reference to what the phase means for patient safety or testing maturity.
The system must ensure that LLM-generated explanation text does not vary in meaning across repeated renders in the same session.
The system must pass all defined UI tests validating phase rendering without visual regression in MessageBubble.
The system must pass end-to-end tests confirming phase data flows correctly from input payload through ChatWindow to final rendered UI.
